newsitem.title: USA: McDermott got Gingrich tape, lawyer says.
newsitem.headline: McDermott got Gingrich tape, lawyer says.

text.p: A Florida couple gave a tape of a monitored conversation between House Speaker Newt Gingrich and his top allies referring to ethics charges against him to the senior Democrat on the House ethics committee, Rep. Jim McDermott, their lawyer said on Monday.
The couple, John and Alice Martin, heard the conversation on a police scanner, lawyer Larry Turner told a news conference.
"They take it to Congressman McDermott and they put it in his hands," Turner said.
He said the Florida couple were in Washington and were referred to McDermott by Rep. Karen Thurman, D-Florida.

Mrs Martin described how she and her husband found their way to the committee room of the House ethics committee. Outside the room, a policeman pointed out McDermott to them, "and we walked in and asked for him...We told him we had something to turn over to the ethics committee...He took the envelope (containing the tape) in his hand and said he would listen to it," she said.
